SITREP · Adversarial architecture · SpaceXAI

Privacy-leaning OpenAI fork with concentrated residual risk

Domain spacexai · tip cursor/spacexai-optimized-surface-0109 · stance: assume merge pressure · full report linked below

Verdict

Architecture is coherent: OAuth account → shared client/snapshot → ChatLog-owned Responses loop → thin platforms. Stream parsing and auth state machines are careful. Residual risk clusters in four places—capability aggregation, dual transport, entitlement/snapshot gaps, and a few under-justified product defaults—not in platform layout.

Structure (what exists)

  • One OAuth parent entry; four subentries (conversation, AI Task, STT, TTS)
  • SpaceXAIClient owns tokens + dual HTTP (SDK Responses + aiohttp media)
  • entity.py owns history convert, stream FSM, tool loop, attachments
  • Typed errors.py taxonomy drives reauth / repair / retry
  • Always store=false; reasoning continuity via encrypted native blobs

Hard to criticize

  • STRONG Layering + typed runtime_data
  • STRONG Provider-adversarial stream validation
  • STRONG Privacy-default store=false
  • STRONG Device-code as first-class auth
  • STRONG Chat model discovery with aliases

Weak areas (ranked)

  • S Capability aggregation — Assist CONTROL + web/X search + code interpreter on one agent
  • S Broad OAuth scopes — includes grok-cli:access until HA-specific client/scopes exist
  • S Attachment host paths sent as provider filenames
  • A Dual transport / SDK pin drift; Imagine MIME hardcoded JPEG; image models not snapshotted
  • A _sdk_lock + unlimited platform concurrency → Responses head-of-line blocking
  • A STT swallows exceptions quietly; AI Task tool-loop cap=10 (vs OpenAI’s much higher)
  • B Forced four subentries at install; entity.py concentration; unavailable-on-429 UX

Critical code paths

  • Auth — credentials → device/browser OAuth → validate account+models → 4 subentries
  • Chat — prompt+identity → ChatLog → stream/tools loop → availability
  • AI Task data — shared chat loop + JSON schema
  • AI Task image — separate Imagine REST (not Responses tool)
  • STT/TTS — aiohttp media endpoints; PCM→WAV off loop
  • Reauth — runtime credential rejection → start_reauth → unique_id match

Upstream will ask

  • Can scopes shrink before merge?
  • Is bare code_interpreter officially supported?
  • Why JPEG MIME / no image model discovery?
  • Separate AI Task iteration budget?
  • Dual-stack forever, or one transport?
  • UI warning when CONTROL + server tools combine?

Recommended next engineering pass (not cosmetics)

  • Threat-model Assist CONTROL × server tools; consider mutual exclusion or explicit confirm copy
  • Split AI Task max iterations; discover/entitle image models; stop hardcoding JPEG
  • Plan transport unification or document dual-stack as permanent with shared auth middleware
  • Cap attachment/STT/image memory; log STT failures; revisit unavailable-on-429
  • Track HA OAuth client + scope reduction as a merge blocker, not a footnote
